title: Bochner Stability for B-stable DIRK Schemes
summary: In Abner J. Salgado and Ignacio Tomas. Diagonally implicit Runge-Kutta schemes: discrete energy-balance laws and compactness properties. J. Number. Math., 31(4):313-341, 2023, the notion of $U$-stability for Diagonally Implicit Runge-Kutta (DIRK) schemes was introduced. Here we establish the equivalence between $U$- and $B$- (algebraic) stability for two- and three-stage DIRK schemes, which then} provides suitable Bochner norm a priori estimates for $B$-stable methods.
